text:
miguel: hi team 744B starting today. on an M1 Mac and trying to bootstrap dev. using chezmoi for dotfiles, fish shell, asdf for python/node. main issues: asdf shims not appearing in new iTerm tabs, docker devcontainer doesn't see OP_SESSION token from op signin, and some npm native modules fail to build with "node-gyp" errors. who to ping?

harper: welcome! quick checklist: ensure your shell init files load asdf for both login and non-login shells. for fish, add `status --is-interactive; and source ~/.asdf/asdf.fish` or put `eval "$(asdf init -)"` in `~/.config/fish/config.fish`. chezmoi templating can manage both files.

miguel: i had `export PATH="$HOME/.asdf/bin:$PATH"` in .zshrc because my template assumed zsh; missed updating fish. added the fish source but new iTerm tabs still miss shims until i `exec fish`. any idea why?

harper: iTerm sometimes starts a login shell depending on profile. add the asdf init to both `config.fish` and `~/.profile` (or the file your terminal uses for login shells). also run `asdf reshim` after installs.

miguel: npm native module error shows `node-gyp: gyp ERR! stack Error: `make` failed with exit code 2` and mentions missing Python or Xcode CLT. installed Xcode CLT but still failing.

harper: on M1 ensure homebrew is /opt/homebrew and you installed `python@3.11` and `pkg-config` and `openssl@3` via brew. set `export LDFLAGS="-L$(brew --prefix openssl@3)/lib"` and `CPPFLAGS` before `npm install`. node-gyp needs python in PATH; asdf python has to be active for that shell.

miguel: ok set LDFLAGS/CPPFLAGS and reinstalled node version via asdf. node -v/npm -v fine now. about devcontainer and OP: i run `op signin` on host and it prints a token but container env doesn't have OP_SESSION_... variable. using VS Code Remote - Containers.

devex-bot: Onboarding note: preferred pattern is to write `op signin my --raw > ~/.op_session_my` and mount that file into the container as a secret with `mounts` or use `postStartCommand` to read token into env. See https://intranet.redwood/dev-setup/devcontainers.

miguel: tried mounting a file via devcontainer.json but VS Code still not passing it to the container env. is there a recommended devcontainer snippet?

harper: use `mounts`: ["source=${localEnv:HOME}/.op_session_my,target=/tmp/op_session_my,type=bind,consistency=cached"] and add `remoteEnv`: {"OP_SESSION_my": "${localEnv:OP_SESSION_my}"} in devcontainer.json, or run `postStartCommand`: `export OP_SESSION_my=$(cat /tmp/op_session_my) && direnv allow`. Note VS Code may not expand localEnv in all versions; else use `postStartCommand` to `echo $(cat /tmp/op_session_my) > /proc/1/environ` (hacky) — prefer remoteEnv or extension secret storage.

miguel: thanks. one weirdness: when i use direnv it complains about `use node` asdf layout not found inside container until i `asdf install` again in container. should i install asdf versions both host and container?

harper: yes, for reproducibility install required runtimes inside the container image (devcontainer base) or make the container mount host asdf installs (not ideal). best is Dockerfile installs for pinned versions or use the `asdf` binary in the container with `~/.tool-versions` copied into the container and run `asdf install` in `postCreateCommand`.

miguel: got it. last small ask: ssh agent forwarding — i need to push to internal git after hopping through a bastion. locally `ssh-add -l` shows my key, but after `ssh -A bastion` `ssh-add -l` on bastion shows nothing.

harper: check `ssh -v -A bastion` output to confirm forwarding. infra sometimes toggles agent forwarding; also ensure your `~/.ssh/config` has `ForwardAgent yes` for bastion host, and that bastion's sshd allows agent forwarding (`AllowAgentForwarding yes`).

infra-bot: Hi Miguel 9164BB 4E6 we have a short-lived bastion lockdown rolling out today which can block agent forwarding for new accounts. If you need immediate exception, DM @harper and REQ-2110 will be opened.

miguel: thanks infra-bot 44D i'll DM harper. overall fixed asdf/fish/init, node/npm native builds, and devcontainer token pattern. will PR a chezmoi tweak to ensure fish support in our onboarding dotfiles. appreciate the help!

harper: welcome aboard 389 please ping #devex if you PR the onboarding repo and we can review.

miguel: will do 44B
